summary: Native Node 24 TypeScript tools in an ESM scope, independent of the CLI source tests' existing CJS/tsx semantics. The installed clash bin remains generated dist/index.js.

key_files.run-tests.ts: Discovers source test files, invokes Node/tsx and Vitest separately, and propagates failure without running later suites. Importable helpers support isolated runner tests.
key_files.bundle-agents.ts: Stages existing plugin runtime and Skills into dist/agents; skips nested runtime/agents to prevent recursive bundles.

verification: Production scripts are included in root strict tsconfig.quality.json. Root executable-scripts.test.ts tests native import guards and agent bundling in a temporary repository fixture.
